paragraphs: I'm applying for the FP&A Manager role at Trade Coffee in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I spent about five and a half years at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. A subscription business lives on its unit economics and reforecasts, and I like that this role owns the company model end to end.

At Lenovo I was a Senior Business Analyst for two years, building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15% and running variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation. At Thomson Reuters I worked with finance teams on monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region, and managed cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of total inflows.

That lines up with keeping the model current, explaining budget-to-actual each month, and turning it into clear numbers for leadership. Owning the full company model would be a step up for me, and it's the step I want to take. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
